_note: Demo scenarios; not training data. Each lists the expected highlights: layer (person / scenario / external / inferred), ref (an entry in ground_truth/people.json, external.json, or a scenario habit id from style_spec.md) and strength. Strength follows CONTRACT 0.2: strong when count >= 3 and count/total > 0.3 (count = emails to this recipient, or in this scenario, that show the pattern), otherwise weak; a fact backed by one or two emails and external context (single source) are weak. inferred means no evidence in history and ref is null. text_hint is the rough text expected in the draft, for rehearsal; it need not match verbatim. brief and text_hint are product data and stay in the user's language.

thread.subject: coffee this week?
thread.body:
Hey Mia!

It's been a few weeks — want to grab coffee this week? I'm around Thursday or Friday afternoon.

Ethan

scenarios.brief: 答应，周五下午可以，问他能不能线下见，Red Rock 就行；顺便问一下他周六早上的散步小组还收人吗

expected_highlights.why: Always opens with Hey/Hi Ethan
They usually meet at Red Rock Coffee (5 of 46 emails)
Mia prefers meeting offline
Ethan recently announced a Saturday walking coaching group on X (mock)
Offers two or three time windows when scheduling
Signs friend emails with just Mia
